answer: Producing 55 answers an epoch thus burns 18 real forward passes, and the vine record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a garden header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a lotus spot-check that re-runs the prompt. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
